policy: Exclude episodes with no clear single topic that the host's ruling relies on (compilations, live grab-bag specials). Applied by hand in Phase 0; a systematic pass over catalog descriptions runs in Phase 1.

excluded.reason: "0: Origin" is a compilation of rulings that were re-ruled in their own later episodes; a majority of its subjects repeat elsewhere in the scorecard.
Live Relay Podcastathon special: a grab-bag of questions from the list (all-in-one computers, dates, pasta, antique vs. retro) with no single topic the ruling rests on.
